purpose: Deterministic Brand+Model identity. Two models are the SAME only when their normalized names are equal or an explicit alias says so. A longer name is never folded into a shorter one by prefix.
algorithm: 1. Model key = NFKC, casefold, '-', '_' and '/' become spaces, whitespace collapsed. Nothing else is stripped.
2. The canonical models of a brand are exactly assets/car_catalog.json models[brand] (read-only) plus aliases below. No other model name exists for matching.

3. A free-text name (a dataset model name, or a record's model) is matched against ALL canonical models of the brand: candidates are those whose key equals the name key or is a whole-word prefix of it. The LONGEST candidate wins (so 'Land Cruiser Prado 2 7' -> 'Land Cruiser Prado', never 'Land Cruiser').

4. The remainder after the winning model key decides acceptance: empty -> exact; starts with an engine descriptor ('2 5', '1 33', '2 7l', '1100', '77 kwh', '(') -> engine_descriptor; otherwise it is a QUALIFIER (the words before the first engine descriptor).

5. A qualifier is accepted only as a trim_qualifier when its key equals a trim of that exact model in car_catalog.json trimsByBrandModel (or an explicit qualifier_trims entry). It is rejected as distinct_vehicle_qualifier if listed in qualifier_distinct. Every other qualifier is rejected as ambiguous_qualifier and quarantined for review. Nothing is guessed.
6. A name that has no canonical model prefix is unresolved and never joins any model.
7. Evidence records are bound to a model by exact key equality (or alias) between record.model and the evidence file model. Prefix relationships never bind.

must_remain_distinct.note: Prado is a separate catalog model; the pilot showed Prado rows contaminating Land Cruiser.

watchlist_not_in_catalog.name: Range Rover
watchlist_not_in_catalog.note: The catalog has NO plain 'Range Rover' model, only Evoque/Sport/Velar/Vogue. Dataset rows named 'Range Rover <engine>' resolve to no canonical model and are excluded everywhere until the product adds that model.

watchlist_not_in_catalog.name: Tiguan Allspace
watchlist_not_in_catalog.note: Not a catalog model and no dataset row carries that name. If it is ever added it must be a separate model, never merged into Tiguan.

watchlist_not_in_catalog.name: Corolla Verso / Spacio / Rumion / SL
watchlist_not_in_catalog.note: Dataset rows 'Corolla Verso ...' etc. have a qualifier that is not a Corolla catalog trim: quarantined as ambiguous_qualifier, not counted as Corolla.
